title: Pride and Prejudice
description: Elizabeth Bennet spars with the proud Mr Darcy while her family hunts for suitable marriages. A sharp comedy of manners about first impressions, pride and money in Regency England.

title: Jane Eyre
description: An orphaned governess takes a post at Thornfield Hall and falls for its moody master. Something in the house is not what it seems, and Jane must decide what she will not sacrifice for love.

title: Frankenstein
description: A young scientist brings a living creature to life, then abandons it in horror. The creature's pursuit of its maker turns the book into a study of responsibility, loneliness and ambition.

title: Dracula
description: Told through letters and journals, a band of friends tracks a Transylvanian count who has come to England. A gothic chase across Europe built on dread and suspense.

title: Rebecca
description: A young bride arrives at Manderley and finds herself haunted by her husband's dead first wife. Secrets of the estate slowly surface in this psychological gothic.

title: The Hobbit
description: Bilbo Baggins is swept from his comfortable home into a dwarf expedition to reclaim a mountain from a dragon. A warm, humorous quest about courage and homecoming.

title: The Fellowship of the Ring
description: Frodo inherits a ring that must be destroyed and sets out with a company of allies. The first part of an epic of friendship, temptation and a world on the brink of war.

title: A Wizard of Earthsea
description: A gifted boy named Ged learns wizardry and unleashes a shadow through his own arrogance. A compact, thoughtful fantasy about naming, balance and accepting yourself.

title: The Left Hand of Darkness
description: An envoy visits a frozen world whose people have no fixed gender, and must win the trust of a disgraced politician. A quiet novel about friendship, politics and cultural difference.

title: Dune
description: House Atreides takes control of the desert planet Arrakis, the only source of a vital spice, and is betrayed. A young heir must survive among its native people as ecology, religion and empire collide.

title: Neuromancer
description: A burned-out hacker is hired for one last job that takes him through cyberspace and orbital stations. The book that defined cyberpunk style.

title: Foundation
description: A mathematician predicts the collapse of a galactic empire and sets up a colony to shorten the dark age that follows. Linked stories of crises solved by wit rather than force.

title: The Martian
description: An astronaut is stranded on Mars after his crew assumes he is dead. He must engineer food, water and communication to survive until rescue, narrated with dry humour.

title: Project Hail Mary
description: A teacher wakes alone on a spaceship with no memory and a mission to save the Earth. Piece by piece he works out what happened and meets an unexpected partner.

title: Station Eleven
description: After a flu pandemic collapses civilization, a travelling Shakespeare company roams the Great Lakes. Timelines braid together actors, survivors and a prophet around one famous actor.

title: The Handmaid's Tale
description: In the theocratic Republic of Gilead, a woman forced into reproductive servitude recalls her earlier life. A chilling look at control over women's bodies and speech.

title: Nineteen Eighty-Four
description: Winston Smith works for a regime that watches everyone and rewrites the past. His small acts of rebellion lead to a confrontation with the Party's power.

title: Brave New World
description: A World State keeps its citizens content through conditioning, drugs and pleasure. A visitor raised outside it exposes what has been given up.

title: The Road
description: A father and son walk south through a burned, ashen America, scavenging and avoiding other survivors. A spare, devastating story about love in a dying world.

title: Beloved
description: Sethe, a formerly enslaved woman in Ohio, is haunted by the daughter she lost. As the past returns in bodily form, the novel confronts the legacy of slavery.

title: The Remains of the Day
description: An ageing English butler takes a road trip and looks back on his years of service and a missed chance at love. A quiet portrait of duty and self-deception.

title: Never Let Me Go
description: Kathy recalls her childhood at Hailsham, a seemingly idyllic school, and her bond with two friends. The truth about their purpose emerges gently and painfully.

title: Normal People
description: Connell and Marianne move in and out of each other's lives from school in Ireland through university. A close study of class, power and affection.

title: The Secret History
description: A scholarship student joins a tight group of classics students at a Vermont college. The narrator reveals early that they killed one of their own, and how it happened.

title: Gone Girl
description: On their anniversary, Amy Dunne disappears and suspicion falls on her husband Nick. Alternating perspectives expose a marriage and the stories each spouse tells.

title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
description: A disgraced journalist and a young hacker investigate a decades-old disappearance in a wealthy Swedish family. A procedural crime novel with dark family history.

title: And Then There Were None
description: Ten strangers are invited to an island and begin dying according to a nursery rhyme. A masterclass in suspicion and a closed-circle puzzle.

title: The Murder of Roger Ackroyd
description: Hercule Poirot, in retirement in a quiet village, investigates the stabbing of a wealthy man. Famous for its surprising solution.

title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
description: Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson investigate a family curse involving a spectral hound on Dartmoor. A mix of detective logic and gothic atmosphere.

title: The Name of the Rose
description: A Franciscan friar and his novice investigate a series of deaths at a medieval Italian abbey. A mystery loaded with theology, semiotics and books.

title: The Night Circus
description: Two young illusionists are bound to a lifelong magical duel staged inside a travelling circus open only at night. A dreamy, sensory romance.

title: Circe
description: The witch Circe, banished to an island, hones her craft and meets gods and heroes including Odysseus. A myth retold from a woman's perspective.

title: The Song of Achilles
description: Patroclus recounts his life and love for Achilles from boyhood through the Trojan War. A tender, tragic retelling of the Iliad.

title: Piranesi
description: Piranesi lives in a vast house of statues and tides and records its wonders in his journals. When strangers appear, the truth about his world begins to unravel.

title: Jonathan Strange & Mr Norrell
description: Two magicians revive English magic during the Napoleonic Wars, and their partnership turns to rivalry. Written in the style of a nineteenth-century novel.

title: The Name of the Wind
description: Innkeeper Kvothe tells the story of his life: a travelling performer's son orphaned young, who becomes a prodigy at a university of magic.

title: Mistborn: The Final Empire
description: A street thief discovers she has rare magical powers and joins a crew plotting to overthrow an immortal tyrant. A heist plot with a detailed metal-based magic system.

title: Good Omens
description: An angel and a demon who like living on Earth team up to prevent the end of the world after the Antichrist is mislaid. A comic apocalypse.

title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
description: Moments before Earth is demolished, Arthur Dent is whisked into space by a friend who turns out to be an alien. A farcical tour of the galaxy.

title: American Gods
description: Shadow, released from prison, becomes the bodyguard of a mysterious old man and is drawn into a war between old gods and new ones across America.

title: The Kite Runner
description: Amir, a privileged boy in Kabul, betrays his loyal friend Hassan. Years later in America he is offered a chance to atone.

title: Where the Crawdads Sing
description: Kya grows up alone in the North Carolina marshes, shunned by the nearby town. Years later she is the main suspect when a local man is found dead.

title: The Hunger Games
description: In a dystopian nation, teenager Katniss volunteers to take her sister's place in a televised fight to the death. A fast story about power and survival.

title: Anne of Green Gables
description: An imaginative orphan girl is mistakenly sent to an elderly brother and sister on Prince Edward Island. A warm story of growing up and belonging.

title: Little Women
description: The four March sisters grow up in New England during and after the Civil War, each chasing her own ambitions. Jo wants to be a writer.

title: The Lies of Locke Lamora
description: Locke Lamora leads a crew of thieves in a canal-laced fantasy city, until a rival schemer threatens everything. Heists, banter and betrayal.

title: Gideon the Ninth
description: Swordswoman Gideon is dragged into a deadly trial in a decaying gothic mansion by her rival, a necromancer heir. Skeletons, snark and mystery.

title: Kindred
description: Dana, a Black woman in 1970s California, is repeatedly pulled back in time to a Maryland plantation. A novel about survival and the legacy of slavery.

title: Parable of the Sower
description: In a collapsing California, a teenager with hyperempathy forms a belief system called Earthseed and leads others north to safety.

title: Pachinko
description: A Korean family endures discrimination and hardship in Japan across four generations, beginning with a girl in a fishing village.

title: Wolf Hall
description: Thomas Cromwell, a blacksmith's son, rises in the court of Henry VIII during the king's attempt to end his marriage. Political fiction in a close present tense.

title: Mexican Gothic
description: A socialite travels to a decaying mansion in the Mexican countryside to check on her cousin. The house and its family hide something sinister.

title: The Haunting of Hill House
description: Four people spend a summer in a notoriously haunted mansion as part of a paranormal study. Eleanor, the loneliest, begins to feel that the house wants her.

title: Eleanor Oliphant Is Completely Fine
description: Eleanor lives a routine, isolated life until an act of kindness at work begins to draw her out. Her past slowly comes into view.

title: Beach Read
description: A romance writer and a literary novelist who live next door make a bet to swap genres over one summer. Banter becomes something more.

title: The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo
description: An ageing film star chooses an unknown journalist to write her biography and recounts her seven marriages and her secrets.

title: Red, White & Royal Blue
description: The son of the US president and a British prince, forced to fake a friendship after a public incident, fall for each other.

title: The Alchemist
description: A shepherd boy in Spain travels to Egypt in search of treasure, guided by omens and an alchemist. A parable about listening to your heart.

title: Sapiens
description: A sweeping history of the human species from the Cognitive Revolution to the present, ranging across agriculture, money, empires and science.

title: The Immortal Life of Henrietta Lacks
description: The story of the woman whose cells became the HeLa line used throughout science, and of her family, who knew nothing about it for decades.

title: Educated
description: A memoir about growing up in a survivalist family in Idaho without formal schooling, and the author's path to university.

title: A Brief History of Time
description: Hawking explains ideas about the Big Bang, black holes and the nature of time for readers without a physics background.
